subject: math
title: 1 question from an earlier lesson
instructions: Work every problem on paper first and show each step. Then type your answer and press Check. You get two tries on each question. Type a fraction like 3/4, a mixed number like 2 1/2, and a power like 3^4.

sections.name: Catch-up
sections.desc: Questions you missed before, with new numbers or a new story. Right on the first try takes one off your list.

items.q: Work out each one. Picture a number line: adding moves you right and subtracting moves you left.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: A hiking trail near a desert lake starts at −7 meters, which means 7 meters below sea level. A hiker climbs up 12 meters, then walks down 13 meters into a canyon. What number gives her height compared with sea level now, in meters?

items.hint: Start at the first number on a number line. The minus sign between two numbers means move left. If you start left of 0 and move left, do you end up closer to 0 or farther from it?
